steps.title: move robowits ee to
steps.code:
# Check right EE height and lift it above wb4 before moving
# wb4 max z is 0.848. Current EE z is 0.854.
# Let's lift right EE to z=0.92, move above behind_wb3, lower to z=0.83, and push towards wb3!

# First, lift right EE to clear any obstacles
lift_pos = [0.6254, -0.2904, 0.92]
move_lift = primitives.call(
    name='move_robowits_ee_to',
    arm='right',
    target_position=lift_pos,
    max_translation=0.1,
    max_steps=48,
    evidence_handles=evidence
)
print("lift ok:", move_lift.ok)

steps.title: move robowits ee to
steps.code:
# Move right EE behind white block 3, above table
# wb3 is at [0.744, -0.153, 0.803].
# The line points from wb3 towards red block: direction (+0.9, +0.43).
# So behind wb3 is at [0.744 - 0.06, -0.153 - 0.03, 0.83] = [0.684, -0.183, 0.83]

# Let's move to [0.684, -0.183, 0.88] first (high enough, above domino height 0.85)
m1 = primitives.call(
    name='move_robowits_ee_to',
    arm='right',
    target_position=[0.684, -0.183, 0.88],
    max_translation=0.1,
    max_steps=48,
    evidence_handles=evidence
)
print("m1 ok:", m1.ok)

# Lower behind wb3 to z=0.82 (mid-height of the domino)
m2 = primitives.call(
    name='move_robowits_ee_to',
    arm='right',
    target_position=[0.684, -0.183, 0.82],
    max_translation=0.1,
    max_steps=48,
    evidence_handles=evidence
)
print("m2 ok:", m2.ok)

# Push forward through white block 3 to trigger the domino chain reaction!
push_target = [0.76, -0.145, 0.82]
push_res = primitives.call(
    name='execute_robowits_ee_control',
    arm='right',
    target_position=push_target,
    evidence_handles=evidence,
    max_translation=0.1,
    repeat_steps=40,
    hold_steps=20
)
print("push ok:", push_res.ok)
